summary: Iteration 14 — Comprehensive verification of the trilingual EditableImage refactor (backend slot metadata + frontend edit overlays + DayGallery migration + SEO + guardrail). 7/7 backend tests passing; full UI flows validated end-to-end against the public preview URL.

issues: Cleared placeholder for the blog.hero slot renders as an empty beige rectangle without the documented 'Sin imagen' label or ImageOff icon (only a plain colored area). Spec allowed either visual; this is fine functionally but the empty-state hint helps editors. Consider rendering the 'Sin imagen' label/icon even on hero-sized slots.

action_items: (Optional) Always show the 'Sin imagen' + ImageOff placeholder content for cleared hero-sized slots so editors get clear visual feedback (currently the area renders as a blank beige rectangle on /blog hero).
critical_code_review_comments: /api/slots PUT correctly uses $set with selective fields — Pydantic exclude_unset semantics verified via test_04 (alt_i18n only does not clobber url).
DELETE /api/slots/{id} returns {url:null, cleared:true} and preserves alt_i18n/caption_i18n as required — verified via tests 5 & 6.
GET response shape stable: always includes exists boolean (true for fresh-and-empty docs too? Test 1 shows exists:false for never-written slot — correct).
Frontend EditableImage exposes data-testid='editable-overlay-*' only when edit mode is ON (0 overlays on /blog before toggle, 8+ after — verified).

DayGallery lightbox migration confirmed by code (lines 62-78 of DayGallery.jsx wrap the lightbox in ). On /viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d we found 30 editable-overlay-day.X.gallery.N nodes in the DOM (matches the 6 days × 5 images of the AD program). Note: clicking a tile while edit mode is ON opens the meta-edit modal instead of the lightbox (by design — overlay button captures the click), so the lightbox is exercised only when edit mode is OFF.
Guardrail bash /app/scripts/lint-no-native-img.sh exits 0 with the expected success message — passes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows: overlays gated by edit mode, meta panel save persists ES+EN, alt rendering switches per locale, clear flow flips cleared=true, re-PUT resets cleared=false, DayGallery overlays present, 9-route regression sweep 0 console/API errors, SEO tags exact counts on noche-en-erg-chebbi)

test_credentials: Not required — endpoints are unauthenticated for the slot API.
seed_data_creation: Temporary slot regression.meta.test_<uuid> created by pytest and dropped via Mongo in the module teardown. Test slot blog.hero used by frontend flow was also deleted (DELETE /api/slots/blog.hero) and removed from Mongo (db.image_slots.delete_one({'_id':'blog.hero'})). Verified existing seed slots (home.hero.0/1, sur.hero, atlas-desierto.hero) are still intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 functional checks from the review request are GREEN. The pytest module backend/tests/test_slots_meta.py is reusable as a regression suite and runs in ~0.7s. Frontend testid conventions used: 'header-edit-mode-toggle' (NOT 'edit-mode-toggle'), 'editable-overlay-<slot>', 'editable-edit-btn-<slot>', 'edit-modal-meta-<slot>', 'edit-modal-meta-lang-{es,en,fr}-<slot>', 'edit-modal-meta-alt-{lang}-<slot>', 'edit-modal-meta-caption-{lang}-<slot>', 'edit-modal-meta-save-<slot>', 'edit-modal-meta-clear-<slot>'. DayGallery tiles use 'day-gallery-tile-<route_id>-<i>' and the lightbox EditableImage slot pattern is 'day.<route_id>.gallery.<i>'. Routes with populated DAY_GALLERIES include atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d (ad-* keys) but NOT marrakech_ergchebbi/programa_4n_5d (me-* keys not present in /app/frontend/src/lib/dayGalleries.js). The native confirm() dialog on 'Vaciar imagen' must be accepted via page.on('dialog', d:d.accept()).
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found — this was a verification-only iteration. The minor design observation about the cleared-hero placeholder is cosmetic, not a regression.
